name: Boku ga Boku ni Koufun Suru Wake ga Nai! ~Onee-chan no Otouto Josou Kyouiku~
original_name: ぼくがボクに興奮するわけがないっ！ ～お姉ちゃんの弟女装教育～
source:
"She really is something, huh... Chisa-senpai..."
"I guess so..."

My classmates sigh as they stare through the window at my older sister, Chisa, eating her lunch in the courtyard. Bathed in warm sunlight, she’s wearing a radiant smile, completely unfazed by all the eyes on her. There was a time when I felt just a tiny bit proud to be her little brother...

"I’m home."
"Welcome back—"
"Augh..."
"Hmm~? What’s wrong? Getting all shy just because the sister everyone adores came to greet you?"

My sister grins at me as I freeze in surprise.

"So, what shall we do today..?"

All I can do is wait in silence for whatever she’s about to propose. The longer the pause, the more certain I am it’ll be something outrageous...

"That’s right, either way, first you’ll have to strip!"

There it was: the [i]other face[/i] of my sister that only I know.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_044.html]official site[/url]]
translation:
“她真不得了啊……千纱学姐。”
“是啊……”

同学们望向庭院里吃午餐的姐姐千纱，纷纷叹息。温暖阳光下，她面带耀眼笑容，完全不在意周围视线。曾经，我也有一点以身为她弟弟为傲……

“我回来了。”
“欢迎回来——”
“呃……”
“嗯～？怎么啦？只是受不了全校崇拜的姐姐来迎接你，就害羞了吗？”

姐姐对僵住的我露出笑容。

“那么，今天要做什么呢……？”

我只能沉默等待她即将提出的事情。沉默越久，我越确定那会是离谱的提议……

“对了，不管怎样，你得先脱光！”

这就是只有我知道的姐姐的“另一面”。

[译自[url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_044.html]官方网站[/url]]
